provider: NOAA via Open-Meteo Ensemble Mean API
documented_native_grid: 0.25 degree (~25 km), distinct from deterministic sampling grids
ensemble_semantics: 31-member GEFS mean and member standard deviation supplied by the ensemble-mean product

historical_response.requested_2026_03_15: HTTP 400: allowed start reported by API as 2026-06-24
historical_response.conclusion: Actual response confirms availability on 2026-06-24, but not enough chronology for the frozen October 2025-August 2026 three-source evaluation. Four-source skill remains unvalidated.

important_limitations: The stored daily spread is a labelled root-sum-square proxy of hourly member standard deviations, not a calibrated probability and not an exact daily-total member spread.
Latest endpoint initialization time is not exposed and is not inferred from retrieval time.
